description: Get monthly account balance history across all accounts — the data behind the Net Worth views in the LunchMoney app. History is monthly. With no month range, returns all available history plus an ephemeral `current` entry for the current month, which is calculated on demand and may change between requests. Only months with data are included.

end_month.description: Optional last month of the range, inclusive, as YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-03). Must not be earlier than start_month and must not be in the future. If set, start_month is also required. For a single month, use the same value as start_month.

start_month.description: Optional first month of the range, inclusive, as YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-01). Must not be in the future. If set, end_month is also required. A full date such as 2026-01-01 is invalid.

name: get_balance_history
